intent: I want to host this repo
_note: tcp, http-server and dhcp-client are optional capabilities of net and must be named: requiring `net` wholesale produced an image that could not serve HTTP or take a lease, while these markers claimed both. Found by round-tripping the intent compiler (intent-B). w14: the repository travels as repo.cpio (pkg(module-asset)), so the image's probe can be a real `git clone`; the file server moved to the FAT32 volume instead, which is a different PRD signal.
